description: Evidence-grounded benchmark dataset for Android fault category diagnosis and action recommendation

records.symptom_description: Battery drops from 100% to 35% overnight while sitting on bedside table with screen turned off
records.diagnostic_observations: Device reports high background battery drain from unoptimized media app wake-locks during Doze state
records.recommended_action_title: Analyze and Limit Background App Drain
records.evidence_source: Samsung One UI Battery Optimization Documentation & Lab Standby Benchmark

records.symptom_description: Rapid battery depletion during ordinary web browsing and messaging, phone barely lasts 5 hours of light use
records.diagnostic_observations: Smooth Display dynamic 120Hz refresh rate combined with high screen brightness draws excessive GPU current
records.recommended_action_title: Adjust Display Refresh Rate and Always-On Display
records.evidence_source: Google Pixel Help: Get the most life from your Pixel phone battery

records.symptom_description: Phone gets warm in pocket and battery percentage visibly drops 1% every two minutes without active screen usage
records.diagnostic_observations: Google Play Services sync loop continuously preventing processor from entering deep sleep state
records.recommended_action_title: Clear Google Play Services Cache and Restart
records.evidence_source: Android Open Source Project (AOSP) Device Idle and Standby Guidelines

records.symptom_description: Severe battery drain started immediately after updating to the latest HyperOS security patch
records.diagnostic_observations: Post-OTA background ART bytecode recompilation and DexOpt indexing running simultaneously
records.recommended_action_title: Connect to Charger Overnight to Complete DexOpt Compilation
records.evidence_source: Android Developers: Optimize app startup and runtime compilation

records.symptom_description: Battery drops precipitously from 40% down to 5% within 10 minutes
records.diagnostic_observations: Fuel gauge IC calibration drift resulting in inaccurate State of Charge (SoC) voltage mapping
records.recommended_action_title: Perform Full Battery Calibration Cycle
records.evidence_source: Motorola Support: Calibrate the battery on your Motorola smartphone

records.symptom_description: My battery drains extremely fast whenever I leave home and walk around outside
records.diagnostic_observations: Continuous cellular antenna transmission power boost while searching for weak fringe 5G signals
records.recommended_action_title: Set Preferred Network Type to LTE/4G When in Low Coverage
records.evidence_source: Samsung Community & Lab Modem Power Consumption Analysis

records.symptom_description: Battery discharges during daytime even when phone stays inside backpack without being touched
records.diagnostic_observations: Background location telemetry request loop by newly installed navigation companion app
records.recommended_action_title: Analyze and Limit Background App Drain
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of battery standby drain pattern

records.symptom_description: Phone loses 30% battery overnight on silent mode, feels lukewarm in the morning
records.diagnostic_observations: Always-On Ambient Display coupled with rogue Bluetooth LE background scan loop
records.recommended_action_title: Reset Network & Bluetooth Settings and Disable AOD
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of overnight battery discharge

records.symptom_description: Device becomes uncomfortably hot to hold while playing 3D graphics games like Genshin Impact
records.diagnostic_observations: High thermal junction temperature on Snapdragon SoC with heavy silicone case trapping heat
records.recommended_action_title: Isolate Heavy Background Tasks and Remove Insulating Cases
records.evidence_source: Samsung Support: Prevent your Galaxy device from overheating

records.symptom_description: Phone gets extremely hot near the USB port while fast charging on a 30W adapter and charging pauses
records.diagnostic_observations: Battery safety protection throttling charge rate due to ambient temperature exceeding 35C
records.recommended_action_title: Unplug Device and Charge on Flat Hard Surface Away From Sunlight
records.evidence_source: Google Pixel Help: Keep your Pixel phone from getting too hot

records.symptom_description: High temperature alert appears after recording 4K 60fps video outdoors for 8 minutes
records.diagnostic_observations: ISP (Image Signal Processor) and continuous sensor readout exceeding thermal dissipation budget
records.recommended_action_title: Switch to 1080p Resolution and Allow Sensor Cooldown
records.evidence_source: OnePlus Community: Device Temperature Management Guidelines

records.symptom_description: Phone is burning hot in hand while simply scrolling through social media apps
records.diagnostic_observations: Suspected rogue third-party background process pinning CPU cores at maximum frequency
records.recommended_action_title: Boot in Safe Mode to Rule Out Malicious Background Apps
records.evidence_source: Android Open Source Project (AOSP) Thermal Mitigation Architecture

records.symptom_description: Phone overheats on dashboard while using Google Maps GPS navigation with screen on in daylight
records.diagnostic_observations: Simultaneous direct sunlight solar radiation, continuous GPS modem lock, and maximum display nits
records.recommended_action_title: Move Phone from Direct Windshield Sunlight and Use AC Vent Mount
records.evidence_source: Motorola Support: Phone gets warm or hot

records.symptom_description: Hinge and upper glass panel get uncomfortably warm during video conferencing calls
records.diagnostic_observations: Dual screen controller driving high refresh rate with hardware encoder active
records.recommended_action_title: Enable Light Performance Mode in Device Care
records.evidence_source: Samsung One UI Performance Profile Technical Whitepaper

records.symptom_description: My phone is hot to touch while sitting on my desk doing nothing
records.diagnostic_observations: Modem signal search loop generating continuous ambient heat
records.recommended_action_title: Toggle Airplane Mode and Perform Soft Reboot
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of idle heating issue

records.symptom_description: Back panel becomes boiling hot whenever 80W SuperVOOC charger is plugged in
records.diagnostic_observations: Charge pump thermal dissipation when room ambient temperature exceeds 30C
records.recommended_action_title: Disconnect Charger and Allow Device to Cool Before Recharging
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of fast charging heat

records.symptom_description: Phone connects to home Wi-Fi network with full bars but shows 'Connected without Internet'
records.diagnostic_observations: Stale DHCP lease assignment or captive portal authentication token expiry
records.recommended_action_title: Forget Network and Toggle Airplane Mode
records.evidence_source: Samsung Support: Galaxy phone Wi-Fi connection issues

records.symptom_description: Wi-Fi disconnects randomly every 5 minutes and reconnects automatically
records.diagnostic_observations: Enterprise or campus router dropping connection due to rotating randomized MAC address
records.recommended_action_title: Switch MAC Address Type from Randomized to Phone MAC
records.evidence_source: Google Pixel Help: Fix Wi-Fi network connection problems

records.symptom_description: Wi-Fi toggle switch is greyed out in settings and cannot be turned on
records.diagnostic_observations: Corrupted wpa_supplicant driver configuration state or system cache conflict
records.recommended_action_title: Reset Network Settings in System Settings
records.evidence_source: OnePlus Support: Reset Wi-Fi, Mobile and Bluetooth configurations

records.symptom_description: Phone connects to 2.4GHz Wi-Fi band but fails to detect 5GHz dual-band SSID
records.diagnostic_observations: Router operating on DFS (Dynamic Frequency Selection) channel 52-144 not allowed by region regulatory domain
records.recommended_action_title: Configure Router 5GHz Channel to Non-DFS Channels 36-48
records.evidence_source: Android Open Source Project (AOSP) Wi-Fi Infrastructure Guide

records.symptom_description: Websites fail to resolve while connected to university Wi-Fi, DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_BAD_CONFIG
records.diagnostic_observations: Conflict between Android Private DNS (DoT) resolver and local institutional gateway
records.recommended_action_title: Change Private DNS from Custom Hostname to Automatic
records.evidence_source: Google Support: Connect to Wi-Fi networks on your Android device

records.symptom_description: Wi-Fi speed is crawling at under 1 Mbps while laptop on same desk gets 150 Mbps
records.diagnostic_observations: Bluetooth audio streaming co-existence interference on crowded 2.4GHz ISM band
records.recommended_action_title: Split Router SSIDs and Connect Phone Specifically to 5GHz Band
records.evidence_source: Samsung Customer Help: Slow Wi-Fi connection troubleshooting

records.symptom_description: Wi-Fi keeps dropping out whenever I walk between rooms in my house
records.diagnostic_observations: Aggressive roaming threshold failure between mesh access points
records.recommended_action_title: Forget Network and Toggle Airplane Mode
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of Wi-Fi roaming dropout

records.symptom_description: Wi-Fi shows exclamation mark and says no internet access available
records.diagnostic_observations: Captive portal check URL response code timeout
records.recommended_action_title: Open Browser and Navigate to Gateway Login Page
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of Wi-Fi no internet exclamation

records.symptom_description: Phone displays 'No Service' or 'Emergency Calls Only' while in downtown area where coverage is good
records.diagnostic_observations: SIM card registration failure with carrier network tower after roaming handover
records.recommended_action_title: Re-seat Physical SIM / Toggle eSIM Profile in SIM Manager
records.evidence_source: Samsung Support: No Service or network error on Galaxy phone

records.symptom_description: Mobile data does not work; 5G icon is present with exclamation mark, phone calls work normally
records.diagnostic_observations: Corrupted or missing Access Point Name (APN) data routing protocol settings
records.recommended_action_title: Reset Access Point Names (APN) to Carrier Default
records.evidence_source: Google Pixel Help: Fix mobile connectivity issues

records.symptom_description: Phone calls drop after exactly 30 seconds of conversation on VoLTE
records.diagnostic_observations: IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) registration handshake timeout with operator core
records.recommended_action_title: Toggle VoLTE and Wi-Fi Calling Off and On
records.evidence_source: OnePlus Support: Cellular call quality troubleshooting

records.symptom_description: Cannot send or receive SMS text messages while mobile data and calls function normally
records.diagnostic_observations: SMSC (Short Message Service Center) number field corrupted in carrier telephony profile
records.recommended_action_title: Verify Carrier SMS Center Number and Clear Carrier Services Cache
records.evidence_source: Motorola Support: Text messaging (SMS/MMS) troubleshooting

records.symptom_description: 5G signal drops to 2G EDGE repeatedly whenever entering indoor buildings
records.diagnostic_observations: Mid-band 5G signal attenuation through building glass with disabled low-band carrier aggregation
records.recommended_action_title: Set Preferred Network Type to LTE to Prevent 2G Dropouts
records.evidence_source: Android Developers: TelephonyManager Network Types

records.symptom_description: Cellular signal bars fluctuate wildly between 4 bars and zero bars every few seconds
records.diagnostic_observations: Network operator provisioning glitch or corrupted network stack cache
records.recommended_action_title: Reset Network Settings (Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth)
records.evidence_source: Samsung One UI Support: Reset Network Settings Guidelines

records.symptom_description: Phone says No SIM card detected even though nano-SIM is firmly seated in tray
records.diagnostic_observations: Oxidation on copper SIM contacts or slightly warped SIM tray alignment
records.recommended_action_title: Clean SIM Copper Contacts with Microfiber Cloth and Re-insert
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of No SIM Card detected error

records.symptom_description: Mobile data keeps switching off on its own every time screen locks
records.diagnostic_observations: Aggressive background battery saver rule disconnecting mobile data when idle
records.recommended_action_title: Turn Off Sleep Standby Optimization in Battery Settings
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of mobile data disconnect on lock

records.symptom_description: Phone won't charge when plugged in; cable feels loose and wobbles inside the USB-C port
records.diagnostic_observations: Pocket lint and compacted debris preventing USB-C plug from making mechanical contact with port pins
records.recommended_action_title: Inspect Port Under Bright Light and Gently Remove Lint with Wooden Pick
records.evidence_source: Samsung Support: Galaxy phone not charging or charging port issues

records.symptom_description: 'Moisture detected in charging port' alert appears and prevents charging, but phone has not been near water
records.diagnostic_observations: High ambient humidity or conductive pocket dust bridging USB-C impedance sensing pins
records.recommended_action_title: Clear USBSettings System App Cache and Air Dry Device
records.evidence_source: Samsung Support: Moisture detected warning on Samsung Galaxy phone

records.symptom_description: Phone charges at a snail pace, takes over 6 hours to go from 10% to 80% on USB-PD charger
records.diagnostic_observations: Damaged CC (Configuration Channel) pin wire in cable forcing fallback to basic 500mA legacy rate
records.recommended_action_title: Replace USB-C Cable with Certified USB-IF Type-C Power Delivery Cable
records.evidence_source: Google Pixel Help: Fix a Pixel phone that won't charge or turn on

records.symptom_description: Phone stops charging at exactly 80% every night and will not reach 100% until morning
records.diagnostic_observations: Wise Charging / Optimized Battery Health feature deliberately halting charge to preserve lithium anode
records.recommended_action_title: Explain Optimized Battery Charging Behavior or Disable in Battery Health
records.evidence_source: OnePlus Support: Optimized night charging feature overview

records.symptom_description: Wireless charging pad flashes red LED and phone does not charge wirelessly
records.diagnostic_observations: Magnetic metal plate inside phone case blocking Qi induction coil alignment
records.recommended_action_title: Remove Case and Center Device Directly on Qi Wireless Transmitter
records.evidence_source: Wireless Power Consortium (WPC) Qi Specification & Troubleshooting

records.symptom_description: Device completely unresponsive, screen black, does not show charging animation when plugged in
records.diagnostic_observations: Deep battery discharge below PMIC UVLO (Under-Voltage Lockout) threshold
records.recommended_action_title: Leave on Wall Charger for 30 Minutes Then Perform Hardware Force Restart
records.evidence_source: Motorola Support: Phone won't charge or power on

records.symptom_description: Phone connects and disconnects charging every few seconds making notification chime ring constantly
records.diagnostic_observations: Intermittent internal wire fracture near cable strain relief collar
records.recommended_action_title: Replace USB Cable and Test Different Wall Adapter
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of intermittent charging disconnect

records.symptom_description: Charging rapidly notification appears for one second then switches back to charging slowly
records.diagnostic_observations: Charger does not support USB-PD 3.0 PPS protocol required for Pixel fast charge negotiation
records.recommended_action_title: Use an Official or PPS-Compatible USB Power Delivery Wall Adapter
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of PPS charging negotiation issue

records.symptom_description: Camera app closes with 'Warning: Camera failed' error immediately upon opening
records.diagnostic_observations: Corrupted camera service cache or background app holding exclusive Camera2 HAL lock
records.recommended_action_title: Clear Camera App Cache and Storage, Then Force Stop
records.evidence_source: Samsung Support: Camera failed error on Samsung Galaxy phone

records.symptom_description: Rear camera produces completely blurry photos; autofocus hunts back and forth and cannot focus on subjects
records.diagnostic_observations: Laser Autofocus (LDAF) ToF sensor window smudged with fingerprint grease or blocked by case cutout
records.recommended_action_title: Gently Clean Camera Lens and Laser Autofocus Window with Microfiber Cloth
records.evidence_source: Google Pixel Help: Fix your Pixel camera app and autofocus

records.symptom_description: Photos taken indoors under LED lighting show dark flickering horizontal lines or banding
records.diagnostic_observations: Camera rolling shutter speed frequency beating with 50Hz/60Hz AC lighting flicker
records.recommended_action_title: Set Anti-Flicker in Camera Settings to Match Regional Grid Frequency (50Hz/60Hz)
records.evidence_source: Android Open Source Project (AOSP) Camera2 Anti-banding Documentation

records.symptom_description: Camera viewfinder lags heavily with 2-second stuttering delay when panning indoors
records.diagnostic_observations: Third-party camera filter integration running unoptimized real-time neural filters on CPU
records.recommended_action_title: Reset Camera App Settings to Default and Test in Safe Mode
records.evidence_source: Android Developers: CameraX Architecture and Preview Performance

records.symptom_description: Front selfie camera shows completely black screen while rear camera works normally
records.diagnostic_observations: Third-party social app holding active background front-facing camera session
records.recommended_action_title: Revoke Camera Permissions for Third-Party Apps and Restart Phone
records.evidence_source: Motorola Support: Camera troubleshooting guide

records.symptom_description: Clicking or rattling mechanical noise heard near camera module when opening camera app
records.diagnostic_observations: OIS (Optical Image Stabilization) gyroscopic voice-coil actuator calibration initialize pulse
records.recommended_action_title: Explain Normal OIS Magnet Suspension Behavior (No Repair Required)
records.evidence_source: Samsung Support: Galaxy phone camera module makes rattling sound

records.symptom_description: My camera freezes every time I tap the shutter button to take a photo
records.diagnostic_observations: HDR+ multi-frame buffer serialization failure due to corrupt cache partition
records.recommended_action_title: Clear Camera App Cache and Storage, Then Force Stop
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of camera shutter freeze

records.symptom_description: Flash does not fire in dark rooms and says flash is disabled due to low battery
records.diagnostic_observations: System power management automatically disabling high-current LED driver below 15% battery
records.recommended_action_title: Charge Phone Above 20% to Re-enable LED Flash Hardware
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of camera flash cutoff

records.symptom_description: Phone displays 'Storage space running out' warning; cannot take photos or update apps even after deleting videos
records.diagnostic_observations: Deleted high-resolution media items retained in Samsung Gallery Recycle Bin for 30-day grace period
records.recommended_action_title: Empty Gallery and My Files Recycle Bin Permanently
records.evidence_source: Samsung Support: Free up storage space on Samsung Galaxy device

records.symptom_description: System storage section consumes over 60GB of 128GB capacity and keeps growing daily
records.diagnostic_observations: Orphaned streaming app offline video chunks and WhatsApp database backup duplicates in app data
records.recommended_action_title: Clean Junk Files Using Files by Google and Clear Streaming App Cache
records.evidence_source: Google Pixel Help: Free up storage on your Google Pixel phone

records.symptom_description: Cannot install new apps from Play Store, error code 'Insufficient storage available' despite 5GB free
records.diagnostic_observations: Google Play Store requires buffer headroom (2x package size + APK staging) for decompression
records.recommended_action_title: Clear Google Play Store Cache and Uninstall One Unused Large App
records.evidence_source: Google Play Help: Fix problems downloading apps with basic troubleshooting

records.symptom_description: System updater fails to install OTA update and says at least 10GB free space required
records.diagnostic_observations: Seamless A/B partition update requires temporary staging payload space on active userdata partition
records.recommended_action_title: Back Up Large Videos to Google Drive and Free 10GB Temporary Space
records.evidence_source: Android Open Source Project (AOSP) A/B (Seamless) System Updates

records.symptom_description: MicroSD card notification constantly says 'Corrupt SD card' or 'Tap to fix' after restart
records.diagnostic_observations: FAT32 / exFAT dirty filesystem bit set due to improper unmounting or failing flash sectors
records.recommended_action_title: Back Up Data on PC and Reformat MicroSD Card to exFAT
records.evidence_source: Motorola Support: SD card format and storage issues

records.symptom_description: Downloaded PDF files and images from browser do not show up in Gallery or Downloads folder
records.diagnostic_observations: Android MediaStore indexing database stale or missing .nomedia flag in parent folder
records.recommended_action_title: Clear Media Storage System Cache and Check for .nomedia File
records.evidence_source: Android Developers: MediaStore API and volume scanning

records.symptom_description: Storage full warning popup won't go away even though I barely have any apps installed
records.diagnostic_observations: Telegram/WhatsApp media auto-download cache filling internal userdata storage
records.recommended_action_title: Clean Junk Files Using Files by Google and Clear Streaming App Cache
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of storage full alert

records.symptom_description: My phone won't let me download anything, says disk is full
records.diagnostic_observations: Temp downloads folder filled with abandoned partial APK downloads
records.recommended_action_title: Clear Downloads Folder and Empty System Trash
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of disk full error

records.symptom_description: Phone stutters and drops frames when swiping between home screen pages and scrolling apps
records.diagnostic_observations: One UI Home launcher cache bloat combined with Window/Transition animation scale latency
records.recommended_action_title: Clear One UI Home Cache and Set Animation Scale to 0.5x in Developer Options
records.evidence_source: Samsung Support: Galaxy phone is slow or freezing

records.symptom_description: Keyboard has a 1-second typing delay; letters appear slowly after tapping keys in chat apps
records.diagnostic_observations: GBoard personal dictionary cache corruption and haptic feedback engine scheduler delay
records.recommended_action_title: Clear Gboard Cache and Storage in Apps Settings
records.evidence_source: Google Pixel Help: Speed up a slow Google Pixel phone

records.symptom_description: Apps frequently reload and refresh when switching back and forth between two apps
records.diagnostic_observations: Low Memory Killer Daemon (LMKD) killing background processes due to high zRAM swap pressure
records.recommended_action_title: Turn Off Memory Extension (Virtual RAM) to Avoid Slow Flash Swapping
records.evidence_source: Android Open Source Project (AOSP) Low Memory Killer Daemon (lmkd)

records.symptom_description: Touch screen occasionally becomes unresponsive for 3 to 5 seconds during intensive scrolling
records.diagnostic_observations: Touch driver interrupt queuing delay caused by thermal throttling of system CPU cluster
records.recommended_action_title: Reboot into Safe Mode to Diagnose Third-Party App Interference
records.evidence_source: OnePlus Support: System smoothness and performance optimization

records.symptom_description: Phone freezes completely and displays 'System UI isn't responding - Wait or Close app'
records.diagnostic_observations: System UI thread ANR (Application Not Responding) triggered by notification queue deadlock
records.recommended_action_title: Perform Hardware Force Restart and Wipe Cache Partition in Recovery Mode
records.evidence_source: Motorola Support: Phone is slow, freezes or restarts unexpectedly

records.symptom_description: Opening apps takes 4 to 6 seconds; everything feels sluggish after installing many shopping apps
records.diagnostic_observations: Multiple third-party apps launching autostart broadcast receivers simultaneously on boot
records.recommended_action_title: Put Unused Apps into Deep Sleep in Battery & Device Care
records.evidence_source: Samsung One UI Support: Device Care Auto Optimization

records.symptom_description: My phone is hanging and freezing constantly when I try to open messages
records.diagnostic_observations: Messages app local SQLite database index fragmentation
records.recommended_action_title: Clear Messages App Cache and Restart Device
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of app launch hang

records.symptom_description: Games stutter heavily with choppy frame drops after 10 minutes of play
records.diagnostic_observations: Aggressive thermal throttling stepping GPU clock down to minimum frequency
records.recommended_action_title: Configure Game Turbo to Balanced Performance Profile
records.evidence_source: Synthetic paraphrase of gaming frame drops
